cards.title: Heterotic standard-model constructions (three net generations)
cards.reference: Braun, He, Ovrut, Pantev, Phys. Lett. B618 (2005) 210; arXiv:hep-th/0501070
assumptions: Heterotic E₈×E₈ on a smooth CY3 with a stable holomorphic bundle
Net chirality index n_gen = |χ|/2 when the bundle index matches the Euler index
This card attaches to a Hodge class with |χ|=6; the cited paper builds concrete bundles on specific manifolds — matching Hodge alone is not that construction
cards.spectrum_summary: The cited construction reports an observable-sector gauge group SU(3)_C×SU(2)_L×U(1)_Y×U(1)_{B−L}, three families of quarks and leptons (with right-handed neutrinos), two Higgs pairs, and no exotic matter in the strong-coupling case. This site only checks the topological necessary condition |χ|=6 for Hodge (73,70); it does not reproduce the bundle cohomology.
cards.honesty: Literature pointer for heterotic 3-generation model-building. Topology here is necessary, not sufficient.
